metadata.title: Stratzy Active Options Algorithms Complete Dump

tooltips.Volatility (ann.): Indicates how much the Algo's returns fluctuate on an annualized basis. Higher volatility means bigger ups and downs in returns, while lower volatility indicates more stable performance.
tooltips.Calmar: Indicates how much return the Algo generates compared to its worst drawdown. Higher values reflect stronger performance with lower downside risk.
tooltips.Sortino: Indicates how well the Algo generates returns while controlling downside risk. Higher values reflect more efficient, downside-controlled performance.
tooltips.Alpha: Indicates how much extra return the Algo generates compared to the benchmark.
tooltips.Beta: Indicates how sensitive the Algo is to market movements compared to the benchmark. A Beta above 1 moves more than the market, below 1 moves less, and near 1 moves with the market.
tooltips.Sharpe Ratio: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.
tooltips.Best Vs Worst Duration: This graph compares the Algo's best and worst performance over time, showing how returns can vary depending on when you start using the Algo.
tooltips.Underwater Plot: This graph shows when the Algo was in loss and how deep those losses were from its previous peak. When the line is at 0, the Algo is performing well; when it drops below 0 (yellow area), the Algo is in a losing phase. Returning to 0 means the Algo has fully recovered back to its previous peak.
tooltips.Distribution of Monthly Returns: This graph shows how the Algo's monthly returns are spread across different return ranges. Each bar represents how many months the Algo delivered returns within that range.
tooltips.Worst 5 Drawdown Periods: This graph shows the five worst drawdown periods of the Algo. Each shaded section shows when losses were deepest and how long those tough phases lasted.

metrics.definition: Indicates the average decline the strategy experiences in downturns, revealing how deep its typical losses go.

metrics.label: Risk : Reward
metrics.definition: Indicates how much the Algo typically earns for every rupee it risks. E.g., 1:3 means it targets ₹3 in reward for every ₹1 of risk.

metrics.label: Frequency of trade
metrics.definition: Indicates how often the Algo trades on average.

metrics.label: Risk
metrics.definition: Indicates the expected volatility of the Algo and is classified into levels like Low, Medium, and High.

metrics.label: Max Drawdown
metrics.definition: Indicates the largest decline the Algo has faced so far, reflecting its most severe historical downturn.

metrics.label: Success Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates the percentage of trades that end in profit. E.g., 70% means 7 out of 10 trades are winners.

metrics.label: Avg Profit in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average gain the Algo earns on its winning trades.

metrics.label: Avg Loss in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average loss the Algo incurs on its losing trades.

metrics.label: Avg Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the average number of days the Algo took to bounce back after experiencing its average drawdown.

metrics.label: Max Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the number of days the Algo took in the past to recover from its worst drawdown to date.

metrics.definition: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.

metrics.definition: Indicates the expected volatility of the Algo and is classified into levels like Low, Medium, and High.

metrics.label: Max Drawdown
metrics.definition: Indicates the largest decline the Algo has faced so far, reflecting its most severe historical downturn.

metrics.label: Success Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates the percentage of trades that end in profit. E.g., 70% means 7 out of 10 trades are winners.

metrics.label: Avg Profit in Trade

metrics.label: Avg Loss in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average loss the Algo incurs on its losing trades.

metrics.label: Avg Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the average number of days the Algo took to bounce back after experiencing its average drawdown.

metrics.label: Max Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the number of days the Algo took in the past to recover from its worst drawdown to date.

metrics.label: Sharpe Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.

tooltips.Volatility (ann.): Indicates how much the Algo's returns fluctuate on an annualized basis. Higher volatility means bigger ups and downs in returns, while lower volatility indicates more stable performance.
tooltips.Calmar: Indicates how much return the Algo generates compared to its worst drawdown. Higher values reflect stronger performance with lower downside risk.
tooltips.Sortino: Indicates how well the Algo generates returns while controlling downside risk. Higher values reflect more efficient, downside-controlled performance.
tooltips.Alpha: Indicates how much extra return the Algo generates compared to the benchmark.
tooltips.Beta: Indicates how sensitive the Algo is to market movements compared to the benchmark. A Beta above 1 moves more than the market, below 1 moves less, and near 1 moves with the market.
tooltips.Sharpe Ratio: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.
tooltips.Best Vs Worst Duration: This graph compares the Algo's best and worst performance over time, showing how returns can vary depending on when you start using the Algo.
tooltips.Underwater Plot: This graph shows when the Algo was in loss and how deep those losses were from its previous peak. When the line is at 0, the Algo is performing well; when it drops below 0 (yellow area), the Algo is in a losing phase. Returning to 0 means the Algo has fully recovered back to its previous peak.
tooltips.Distribution of Monthly Returns: This graph shows how the Algo's monthly returns are spread across different return ranges. Each bar represents how many months the Algo delivered returns within that range.
tooltips.Worst 5 Drawdown Periods: This graph shows the five worst drawdown periods of the Algo. Each shaded section shows when losses were deepest and how long those tough phases lasted.

metrics.label: Risk : Reward
metrics.definition: Indicates how much the Algo typically earns for every rupee it risks. E.g., 1:3 means it targets ₹3 in reward for every ₹1 of risk.

metrics.label: Frequency of trade
metrics.definition: Indicates how often the Algo trades on average.

metrics.label: Risk
metrics.definition: Indicates the expected volatility of the Algo and is classified into levels like Low, Medium, and High.

metrics.label: Max Drawdown
metrics.definition: Indicates the largest decline the Algo has faced so far, reflecting its most severe historical downturn.

metrics.label: Success Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates the percentage of trades that end in profit. E.g., 70% means 7 out of 10 trades are winners.

metrics.label: Avg Profit in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average gain the Algo earns on its winning trades.

metrics.label: Avg Loss in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average loss the Algo incurs on its losing trades.

metrics.label: Avg Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the average number of days the Algo took to bounce back after experiencing its average drawdown.

metrics.label: Max Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the number of days the Algo took in the past to recover from its worst drawdown to date.

metrics.label: Sharpe Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.

tooltips.Volatility (ann.): Indicates how much the Algo's returns fluctuate on an annualized basis. Higher volatility means bigger ups and downs in returns, while lower volatility indicates more stable performance.
tooltips.Calmar: Indicates how much return the Algo generates compared to its worst drawdown. Higher values reflect stronger performance with lower downside risk.
tooltips.Sortino: Indicates how well the Algo generates returns while controlling downside risk. Higher values reflect more efficient, downside-controlled performance.
tooltips.Alpha: Indicates how much extra return the Algo generates compared to the benchmark.
tooltips.Beta: Indicates how sensitive the Algo is to market movements compared to the benchmark. A Beta above 1 moves more than the market, below 1 moves less, and near 1 moves with the market.
tooltips.Sharpe Ratio: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.
tooltips.Best Vs Worst Duration: This graph compares the Algo's best and worst performance over time, showing how returns can vary depending on when you start using the Algo.
tooltips.Underwater Plot: This graph shows when the Algo was in loss and how deep those losses were from its previous peak. When the line is at 0, the Algo is performing well; when it drops below 0 (yellow area), the Algo is in a losing phase. Returning to 0 means the Algo has fully recovered back to its previous peak.
tooltips.Distribution of Monthly Returns: This graph shows how the Algo's monthly returns are spread across different return ranges. Each bar represents how many months the Algo delivered returns within that range.
tooltips.Worst 5 Drawdown Periods: This graph shows the five worst drawdown periods of the Algo. Each shaded section shows when losses were deepest and how long those tough phases lasted.

tooltips.Volatility (ann.): Indicates how much the Algo's returns fluctuate on an annualized basis. Higher volatility means bigger ups and downs in returns, while lower volatility indicates more stable performance.

metrics.label: Risk : Reward
metrics.definition: Indicates how much the Algo typically earns for every rupee it risks. E.g., 1:3 means it targets ₹3 in reward for every ₹1 of risk.

metrics.label: Frequency of trade
metrics.definition: Indicates how often the Algo trades on average.

metrics.label: Risk
metrics.definition: Indicates the expected volatility of the Algo and is classified into levels like Low, Medium, and High.

metrics.label: Max Drawdown
metrics.definition: Indicates the largest decline the Algo has faced so far, reflecting its most severe historical downturn.

metrics.label: Success Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates the percentage of trades that end in profit. E.g., 70% means 7 out of 10 trades are winners.

metrics.label: Avg Profit in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average gain the Algo earns on its winning trades.

metrics.label: Avg Loss in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average loss the Algo incurs on its losing trades.

metrics.label: Avg Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the average number of days the Algo took to bounce back after experiencing its average drawdown.

metrics.label: Max Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the number of days the Algo took in the past to recover from its worst drawdown to date.

metrics.label: Sharpe Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.

tooltips.Volatility (ann.): Indicates how much the Algo's returns fluctuate on an annualized basis. Higher volatility means bigger ups and downs in returns, while lower volatility indicates more stable performance.
tooltips.Calmar: Indicates how much return the Algo generates compared to its worst drawdown. Higher values reflect stronger performance with lower downside risk.
tooltips.Sortino: Indicates how well the Algo generates returns while controlling downside risk. Higher values reflect more efficient, downside-controlled performance.
tooltips.Alpha: Indicates how much extra return the Algo generates compared to the benchmark.
tooltips.Beta: Indicates how sensitive the Algo is to market movements compared to the benchmark. A Beta above 1 moves more than the market, below 1 moves less, and near 1 moves with the market.
tooltips.Sharpe Ratio: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.
tooltips.Best Vs Worst Duration: This graph compares the Algo's best and worst performance over time, showing how returns can vary depending on when you start using the Algo.
tooltips.Underwater Plot: This graph shows when the Algo was in loss and how deep those losses were from its previous peak. When the line is at 0, the Algo is performing well; when it drops below 0 (yellow area), the Algo is in a losing phase. Returning to 0 means the Algo has fully recovered back to its previous peak.
tooltips.Distribution of Monthly Returns: This graph shows how the Algo's monthly returns are spread across different return ranges. Each bar represents how many months the Algo delivered returns within that range.
tooltips.Worst 5 Drawdown Periods: This graph shows the five worst drawdown periods of the Algo. Each shaded section shows when losses were deepest and how long those tough phases lasted.

metrics.definition: Indicates the largest decline the Algo has faced so far, reflecting its most severe historical downturn.

metrics.label: Avg Loss in Trade

metrics.label: Max Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the number of days the Algo took in the past to recover from its worst drawdown to date.

metrics.label: Sharpe Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.

tooltips.Volatility (ann.): Indicates how much the Algo's returns fluctuate on an annualized basis. Higher volatility means bigger ups and downs in returns, while lower volatility indicates more stable performance.
tooltips.Calmar: Indicates how much return the Algo generates compared to its worst drawdown. Higher values reflect stronger performance with lower downside risk.
tooltips.Sortino: Indicates how well the Algo generates returns while controlling downside risk. Higher values reflect more efficient, downside-controlled performance.
tooltips.Alpha: Indicates how much extra return the Algo generates compared to the benchmark.
tooltips.Beta: Indicates how sensitive the Algo is to market movements compared to the benchmark. A Beta above 1 moves more than the market, below 1 moves less, and near 1 moves with the market.
tooltips.Sharpe Ratio: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.
tooltips.Best Vs Worst Duration: This graph compares the Algo's best and worst performance over time, showing how returns can vary depending on when you start using the Algo.
tooltips.Underwater Plot: This graph shows when the Algo was in loss and how deep those losses were from its previous peak. metrics.label: Avg. Drawdown
metrics.definition: Indicates the average decline the strategy experiences in downturns, revealing how deep its typical losses go.

metrics.label: Risk : Reward
metrics.definition: Indicates how much the Algo typically earns for every rupee it risks. E.g., 1:3 means it targets ₹3 in reward for every ₹1 of risk.

metrics.label: Frequency of trade
metrics.definition: Indicates how often the Algo trades on average.

metrics.label: Risk
metrics.definition: Indicates the expected volatility of the Algo and is classified into levels like Low, Medium, and High.

metrics.label: Max Drawdown
metrics.definition: Indicates the largest decline the Algo has faced so far, reflecting its most severe historical downturn.

metrics.label: Success Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates the percentage of trades that end in profit. E.g., 70% means 7 out of 10 trades are winners.

metrics.label: Avg Profit in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average gain the Algo earns on its winning trades.

metrics.label: Avg Loss in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average loss the Algo incurs on its losing trades.

metrics.label: Avg Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the average number of days the Algo took to bounce back after experiencing its average drawdown.

metrics.label: Max Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the number of days the Algo took in the past to recover from its worst drawdown to date.

metrics.label: Sharpe Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.

tooltips.Volatility (ann.): Indicates how much the Algo's returns fluctuate on an annualized basis. Higher volatility means bigger ups and downs in returns, while lower volatility indicates more stable performance.
tooltips.Calmar: Indicates how much return the Algo generates compared to its worst drawdown. Higher values reflect stronger performance with lower downside risk.
tooltips.Sortino: Indicates how well the Algo generates returns while controlling downside risk. Higher values reflect more efficient, downside-controlled performance.
tooltips.Alpha: Indicates how much extra return the Algo generates compared to the benchmark.
tooltips.Beta: Indicates how sensitive the Algo is to market movements compared to the benchmark. A Beta above 1 moves more than the market, below 1 moves less, and near 1 moves with the market.
tooltips.Sharpe Ratio: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.
tooltips.Best Vs Worst Duration: This graph compares the Algo's best and worst performance over time, showing how returns can vary depending on when you start using the Algo.
tooltips.Underwater Plot: This graph shows when the Algo was in loss and how deep those losses were from its previous peak. When the line is at 0, the Algo is performing well; when it drops below 0 (yellow area), the Algo is in a losing phase. Returning to 0 means the Algo has fully recovered back to its previous peak.
tooltips.Distribution of Monthly Returns: This graph shows how the Algo's monthly returns are spread across different return ranges. Each bar represents how many months the Algo delivered returns within that range.
tooltips.Worst 5 Drawdown Periods: This graph shows the five worst drawdown periods of the Algo. Each shaded section shows when losses were deepest and how long those tough phases lasted.

metrics.label: Avg. Drawdown
metrics.definition: Indicates the average decline the strategy experiences in downturns, revealing how deep its typical losses go.

metrics.label: Risk : Reward
metrics.definition: Indicates how much the Algo typically earns for every rupee it risks. E.g., 1:3 means it targets ₹3 in reward for every ₹1 of risk.

metrics.label: Frequency of trade
metrics.definition: Indicates how often the Algo trades on average.

metrics.label: Risk
metrics.definition: Indicates the expected volatility of the Algo and is classified into levels like Low, Medium, and High.

metrics.label: Max Drawdown
metrics.definition: Indicates the largest decline the Algo has faced so far, reflecting its most severe historical downturn.

metrics.label: Success Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates the percentage of trades that end in profit. E.g., 70% means 7 out of 10 trades are winners.

metrics.label: Avg Profit in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average gain the Algo earns on its winning trades.

metrics.label: Avg Loss in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average loss the Algo incurs on its losing trades.

metrics.label: Avg Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the average number of days the Algo took to bounce back after experiencing its average drawdown.

metrics.label: Max Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the number of days the Algo took in the past to recover from its worst drawdown to date.

metrics.label: Sharpe Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.

tooltips.Volatility (ann.): Indicates how much the Algo's returns fluctuate on an annualized basis. Higher volatility means bigger ups and downs in returns, while lower volatility indicates more stable performance.
tooltips.Calmar: Indicates how much return the Algo generates compared to its worst drawdown. Higher values reflect stronger performance with lower downside risk.
tooltips.Sortino: Indicates how well the Algo generates returns while controlling downside risk. Higher values reflect more efficient, downside-controlled performance.
tooltips.Alpha: Indicates how much extra return the Algo generates compared to the benchmark.
tooltips.Beta: Indicates how sensitive the Algo is to market movements compared to the benchmark. A Beta above 1 moves more than the market, below 1 moves less, and near 1 moves with the market.
tooltips.Sharpe Ratio: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.
tooltips.Best Vs Worst Duration: This graph compares the Algo's best and worst performance over time, showing how returns can vary depending on when you start using the Algo.
tooltips.Underwater Plot: This graph shows when the Algo was in loss and how deep those losses were from its previous peak. When the line is at 0, the Algo is performing well; when it drops below 0 (yellow area), the Algo is in a losing phase. Returning to 0 means the Algo has fully recovered back to its previous peak.
tooltips.Distribution of Monthly Returns: This graph shows how the Algo's monthly returns are spread across different return ranges. Each bar represents how many months the Algo delivered returns within that range.
tooltips.Worst 5 Drawdown Periods: This graph shows the five worst drawdown periods of the Algo. Each shaded section shows when losses were deepest and how long those tough phases lasted.

metrics.label: Avg. Drawdown
metrics.definition: Indicates the average decline the strategy experiences in downturns, revealing how deep its typical losses go.

metrics.label: Risk : Reward
metrics.definition: Indicates how much the Algo typically earns for every rupee it risks. E.g., 1:3 means it targets ₹3 in reward for every ₹1 of risk.

metrics.label: Frequency of trade
metrics.definition: Indicates how often the Algo trades on average.

metrics.label: Risk
metrics.definition: Indicates the expected volatility of the Algo and is classified into levels like Low, Medium, and High.

metrics.label: Max Drawdown
metrics.definition: Indicates the largest decline the Algo has faced so far, reflecting its most severe historical downturn.

metrics.label: Success Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates the percentage of trades that end in profit. E.g., 70% means 7 out of 10 trades are winners.

metrics.label: Avg Profit in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average gain the Algo earns on its winning trades.

metrics.label: Avg Loss in Trade
metrics.definition: Indicates the average loss the Algo incurs on its losing trades.

metrics.label: Avg Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the average number of days the Algo took to bounce back after experiencing its average drawdown.

metrics.label: Max Time to Recovery
metrics.definition: Indicates the number of days the Algo took in the past to recover from its worst drawdown to date.

metrics.label: Sharpe Ratio
metrics.definition: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.

tooltips.Volatility (ann.): Indicates how much the Algo's returns fluctuate on an annualized basis. Higher volatility means bigger ups and downs in returns, while lower volatility indicates more stable performance.
tooltips.Calmar: Indicates how much return the Algo generates compared to its worst drawdown. Higher values reflect stronger performance with lower downside risk.
tooltips.Sortino: Indicates how well the Algo generates returns while controlling downside risk. Higher values reflect more efficient, downside-controlled performance.
tooltips.Alpha: Indicates how much extra return the Algo generates compared to the benchmark.
tooltips.Beta: Indicates how sensitive the Algo is to market movements compared to the benchmark. A Beta above 1 moves more than the market, below 1 moves less, and near 1 moves with the market.
tooltips.Sharpe Ratio: Indicates how well an Algo balances risk and return, showing how effectively it manages volatility.
tooltips.Best Vs Worst Duration: This graph compares the Algo's best and worst performance over time, showing how returns can vary depending on when you start using the Algo.
tooltips.Underwater Plot: This graph shows when the Algo was in loss and how deep those losses were from its previous peak. When the line is at 0, the Algo is performing well; when it drops below 0 (yellow area), the Algo is in a losing phase. Returning to 0 means the Algo has fully recovered back to its previous peak.
tooltips.Distribution of Monthly Returns: This graph shows how the Algo's monthly returns are spread across different return ranges. Each bar represents how many months the Algo delivered returns within that range.
tooltips.Worst 5 Drawdown Periods: This graph shows the five worst drawdown periods of the Algo. Each shaded section shows when losses were deepest and how long those tough phases lasted.
